Building a calm feed reader

A useful reader starts by preserving the author's argument instead of surrounding it with menus, advertisements and unrelated recommendations. It keeps paragraphs in their original order and makes references understandable without requiring the source website's layout.

The extraction stage should remain deliberately conservative. When a page contains enough coherent prose, InkRiver can retain the result for offline reading. When the page is only a teaser, the RSS summary remains the safer fallback and the original link stays available.
